# H&M:s rapport missar förväntningarna – chiprapport lugnar i USA

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-06-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode opens on renewed AI optimism after Micron crushed earnings expectations, lifting sentiment across global markets. The core discussion centres on H&M's weak Q-report, which missed sales expectations and reinforced the analyst's standing sell view, contrasted with better-executing peers Inditex and Fast Retailing. A secondary theme is a >13bn SEK property transaction where Wihlborgs buys assets from Castellum, plus broad caution on consumer/durables names ahead of Q2.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 HM-B — Hennes & Mauritz (H&M) | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

Standing sell recommendation; Q-report missed sales, no growth, margin gains exhausted vs tougher H2 comps, valuation ~18x 2027e not cheap.

#### Reasoning

Analyst Lukas Mattsson maintains a sell. Sales of 54.8bn missed 55.3bn expected with no local-currency growth; profit growth is purely from cost savings/margins, which are now near exhausted against tougher H2 comparisons. Even assuming 3-5% growth and ~9% margins, 2027e trades at 18x earnings — not cheap given execution uncertainty. Few short-term positive drivers; long-term case rests on a possible buyout.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth materialises from store/online/nearshoring initiatives
- if a take-private/buyout bid emerges
- if valuation falls well below 18x 2027e earnings

> *"Just nu så tycker vi att det finns få positiva drivare i caset kortsiktigt och därför sa vi en sälj."*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pareto raised recommendation to buy from hold; stock up ~3%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst signal: Pareto upgraded Saab to buy from hold, and the share traded up around 3% on the morning. No host conviction added beyond reporting the upgrade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Pareto downgrades
- if defence order momentum slows

> *"Saab har fått en höjd rekommendation till köp från tidigare behåll från Pareto."*

---

### 🟢 NCAB — NCAB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SEB raised recommendation to buy from hold; stock up over 6%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst signal: SEB upgraded NCAB to buy from hold, with the share up more than 6% on the session. Reported as market news rather than a host thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SEB downgrades
- if PCB demand weakens

> *"Noterar att NCAB är upp över 6% där har SEB hyrt sin... Rekommendation till köp från tidigare behåll"*

---

### 🟠 ITX — Inditex (Zara) | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Described as best-in-class on trend reactivity with strong spring sales, outclassing H&M on results and share price.

#### Reasoning

Host frames Inditex as the best-in-class operator, with a 50-year nearshore supply chain enabling rapid trend response, strong spring sales, and superior margins and share-price performance versus H&M. Positive qualitative view but no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales momentum fades
- if margins compress

> *"Inditex är ju liksom bäst in class egentligen på att reagera på trender."*

---

### ⛔ HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Grouped with expensive-durables names hurt by a discount-driven, weak consumer; no 2026 consumption lift expected.

#### Reasoning

Host expects no consumer-spending lift in 2026 and sees the consumer as rebate-driven. Companies selling expensive durable goods — Electrolux, Nobia, Husqvarna — are disadvantaged in this climate, with Q2 also exposed to rising input/energy costs from Middle East conflict.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer discretionary demand recovers
- if input/energy cost pressure eases

> *"De bolag som har väldigt dyra sällanköpsvaror missynas av detta. Det har de gjort också. Vi har sett Electrolux, Nobia, Husqvarna och så vidare."*

---

### ⛔ ELUX-B — Electrolux | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Cited among expensive-durables losers as the consumer stays cautious and rebate-driven into 2026.

#### Reasoning

Same consumer thesis: expensive durable-goods sellers are pressured by a weak, discount-driven consumer with no 2026 spending lift, plus potential Q2 margin pressure from higher raw-material and energy prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer spending rebounds
- if cost pressures ease

> *"Vi har sett Electrolux, Nobia, Husqvarna och så vidare."*

---

### ⛔ NOBI — Nobia | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named among expensive durable-goods companies hurt by weak consumer demand.

#### Reasoning

Grouped with Electrolux and Husqvarna as expensive-durables names disadvantaged by a cautious, rebate-driven consumer with no expected 2026 consumption lift.

#### Sell Triggers

- if housing/renovation demand recovers
- if consumer confidence improves

> *"De bolag som har väldigt dyra sällanköpsvaror missynas av detta."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Low-price retailers fare better with a rebate-driven consumer, but valuations have risen, leaving little room for disappointment.

#### Reasoning

Host notes low-price players (Clas Ohlson, Rusta, Tokmanni) feel better in the current discount-driven climate, but their valuations have already re-rated to relatively high levels, leaving little margin for any earnings disappointment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation multiples compress on a miss
- if consumer trades back up to full-price retail

> *"Lågprisaktörerna då, Rusta, Claes Olsson, Polio i Finland gynnas... samtidigt så har ju värderingar på de här bolagen kommit upp också."*
